decision.rationale: The disputed charge TXN-007890 on card CRD-000050 was made at Lumen Media (MER-000035) on 2026-09-21 for 1812 EUR minor units and posted on 2026-09-22. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 31 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000015, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-25. That is 4 days after the charge on 2026-09-21. The charge therefore covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: The 18.12 EUR Lumen Media charge was made on 2026-09-21.
